class.name: RadioCommunicationsFamilyPdu
class.comment: Abstract superclass for radio communications PDUs. Section 7.7

class.name: RadioCommsHeader
class.comment: Common PDU fields for Radio Communications family: Radio Identifier record, Section 6.2.70.

attribute.name: radioReferenceID
attribute.comment: ID of the entitythat is the source of the communication

class.name: TransmitterPdu
class.comment: 7.7.2 Communicates the state of a particular radio transmitter or simple intercom.

attribute.name: variableTransmitterParameterCount
attribute.comment: Number of Variable Transmitter Parameters records (N) in the parameter records section, Table 176

attribute.name: antennaPatternCount
attribute.comment: Antenna Pattern Length (A): length in octets of the Antenna Pattern record in the parameter records section, Table 176. Zero = no record

attribute.name: modulationParameterCount
attribute.comment: Length of Modulation Parameters (M): length in octets of the Modulation Parameters record in the parameter records section, Table 176. Zero = no record (Section 7.7.2 s)

attribute.name: modulationParameters
attribute.comment: optional single Modulation Parameters record; length in octets is the modulationParameterCount field

attribute.name: antennaPattern
attribute.comment: optional single Antenna Pattern record; length in octets is the antennaPatternCount field. Omni-directional (0) carries no record; values beyond Beam (1) are reserved

attribute.name: variableTransmitterParameters
attribute.comment: variable length list of Variable Transmitter Parameters records

class.name: SignalPdu
class.comment: 7.7.3 Conveys the audio or digital data carried by the simulated radio or intercom transmission.

attribute.name: padTo32
attribute.comment: Wireshark (incorrectly) reports malformed packet unless the whole datagram is aligned to 32-bit boundary; spec says only the pdu

class.name: IntercomSignalPdu
class.comment: 7.7.5 Conveys the audio or digital data that is used to communicate between simulated intercom devices

attribute.name: intercomReferenceID
attribute.comment: The unique designation of an attached or unattached intercom in an event or exercise

attribute.name: padTo32
attribute.comment: Wireshark (incorrectly) reports malformed packet unless the whole datagram is aligned to 32-bit boundary; spec says only the pdu

class.name: ReceiverPdu
class.comment: 7.7.4 Communicates the state of a particular radio receiver. Its primary application is in communicating state information to radio network monitors, data loggers, and similar applications for use in debugging, supervision, and after-action review.

class.name: IntercomReferenceID
class.comment: unique reference ID for this intercom; reference-ID portion of the Intercom Identifier record, Section 6.2.47.

class.name: IntercomControlPdu
class.comment: 7.7.6 Communicates the state of a particular intercom device, request an action of another intercom device, or respond to an action request.

attribute.name: sourceEntityID
attribute.comment: Source entity ID, this can also be ObjectIdentifier or UnattachedIdentifier

attribute.name: sourceIntercomNumber
attribute.comment: The specific intercom device being simulated within an entity.

attribute.name: sourceLineID
attribute.comment: Line number to which the intercom control refers

attribute.name: transmitPriority
attribute.comment: priority of this message relative to transmissons from other intercom devices

attribute.name: transmitLineState
attribute.comment: current transmit state of the line

attribute.name: masterIntercomReferenceID
attribute.comment: eid of the entity that has created this intercom channel, same comments as sourceEntityId

attribute.name: masterIntercomNumber
attribute.comment: specific intercom device that has created this intercom channel

class.name: ModulationParametersRecord
class.comment: Base for Modulation Parameters records. Record-specific fields vary by radio system and are defined in Annex C; the total length of each record shall be a multiple of 64 bits (Table 89). Section 6.2.58

class.name: GenericRadio
class.comment: Annex C.2 Generic radio. Identified by Radio System = Generic Radio or Simple Intercom (1) with any nonzero Major Modulation. There are no specific Transmitter, Signal, or Receiver PDU requirements unique to a generic radio; the record is zero-length.

class.name: SimpleIntercomRadio
class.comment: Annex C.3 Simple Intercom. Identified by Radio System = Generic Radio or Simple Intercom (1) and Major Modulation = No Statement (0). The Length of Modulation Parameters shall be set to zero (Annex C.3.2.2 h); the record is zero-length.

class.name: BasicHaveQuickMP
class.comment: Basic HAVE QUICK Modulation Parameters record (Annex C.4.2.2, Table C.3, 128 bits). Used by the Basic option of HAVE QUICK I/II/IIA (Radio System 2, 3, 4) and also required by the High-Fidelity option; shall be included regardless of the Spread Spectrum field.

attribute.name: netId
attribute.comment: NET ID record (Annex C.4.2.4, Table C.5) packed in 16 bits: Net Number bits 0-9, Frequency Table [UID 299] bits 10-11, Mode [UID 298] bits 12-13, padding bits 14-15, where bit 0 is the most significant (first transmitted) bit. Represents an Operational Net NXX.XYY

attribute.name: mwodIndex
attribute.comment: Index into the MWOD Index - WOD Correlation Table provided by the exercise agreement; when unknown, the default maintenance and training value 1 shall be used (Annex C.4.2.2 b, Table C.2)

attribute.name: reserved16
attribute.comment: 16 bits reserved; unused and reserved bits shall be set to zero (Annex C.4.2.1)

attribute.name: reserved8_1
attribute.comment: 8 bits reserved; shall be zero (Annex C.4.2.1)

attribute.name: reserved8_2
attribute.comment: 8 bits reserved; shall be zero (Annex C.4.2.1)

attribute.name: timeOfDay
attribute.comment: representative Time of Day for the radio; a value of zero shall be considered a match to any other value received (Annex C.4.2.2 c)

class.name: CCTTSincgarsMP
class.comment: CCTT SINCGARS Modulation Parameters record (Annex C.6.2.3, Table C.7, 128 bits). Radio System = CCTT SINCGARS (6); the record shall always be included in the Transmitter PDU.

attribute.name: fhNetId
attribute.comment: frequency hopping network identity (Annex C.6.2.3 a)

attribute.name: hopSetId
attribute.comment: set of frequencies used when creating a hopping pattern (Annex C.6.2.3 b)

attribute.name: lockoutSetId
attribute.comment: set of frequencies excluded from the hopping pattern (Annex C.6.2.3 c)

attribute.name: startOfMessage
attribute.comment: whether the radio is starting or continuing a transmission; a CCTT SINCGARS radio shall not receive any part of an FH transmission if the Start of Message is missed (Annex C.6.2.3 d)

attribute.name: clearChannel
attribute.comment: transmission is not subject to propagation loss, interference, COMSEC, or any other form of signal degradation (Annex C.6.2.3 e)

attribute.name: fhSyncTimeOffset
attribute.comment: offset to exercise time in seconds for the clock in the CCTT SINCGARS radio; all bits set to zero if no synchronization simulation is required (Annex C.6.2.3 f)

attribute.name: transmissionSecurityKey
attribute.comment: transmission security key used when generating the hopping pattern; set to zero if no key value is included (Annex C.6.2.3 g)

class.name: AntennaPatternRecord
class.comment: Base for Antenna Pattern records. Antenna pattern records are non-self-identifying: the Transmitter PDU Antenna Pattern Type field identifies the record type and the Antenna Pattern Length field gives the record length in octets; the total length of each record shall be a multiple of 64 bits. Section 6.2.8

class.name: VariableTransmitterParametersRecord
class.comment: Base for Variable Transmitter Parameters records in the standard variable record format of 6.2.83: Record Type [UID 66], Record Length in octets (a multiple of 8), record-specific fields, and padding to a 64-bit boundary. The record types applicable to a radio system are identified in Annex C. Section 6.2.95

class.name: HighFidelityHAVEQUICKRadio
class.comment: High-Fidelity HAVE QUICK Variable Transmitter Parameters record (Annex C.4.2.3, Table C.4). Record Type 3000, Record Length 40 octets, 320 bits total; required in addition to the Basic HAVE QUICK MP record when the High-Fidelity option is modeled.

attribute.name: recordType
attribute.comment: Record Type = 3000, the High Fidelity HAVE QUICK enumeration [UID 66]

attribute.name: recordLength
attribute.comment: Record Length in octets = 40 (the whole record, Table C.4)

attribute.name: netId
attribute.comment: NET ID record (Annex C.4.2.4, Table C.5) packed in 16 bits: Net Number bits 0-9, Frequency Table [UID 299] bits 10-11, Mode [UID 298] bits 12-13, padding bits 14-15, where bit 0 is the most significant (first transmitted) bit. Represents an Operational Net NXX.XYY

attribute.name: todTransmitIndicator
attribute.comment: whether a Time of Day is being transmitted, also referred to as a Mickey (Annex C.4.2.3 c)

attribute.name: todDelta
attribute.comment: difference between the transceiver internal clock and the reference clock, in hundreds of microseconds, signed; zero means synchronized with the reference clock (Annex C.4.2.3 d)

attribute.name: wod1
attribute.comment: Word of Day 1; the six WODs collectively are an MWOD, each containing six decimal digits with notation like 300.025 (Annex C.4.2.3 f)
